scope.purpose: Define organization-wide principles for assigning authority to governed roles and for specializing those assignments at project level without allowing execution mechanisms to create authority.
non_goals: No personal names or HR data
No tool UI or platform configuration procedures
No duplication of downstream coordination, acceptance, semantic, or toolchain procedures

requirements.statement: Authority shall be assigned to governed roles and bounded by authority domain, governance layer, scope, information state, and declared purpose.

Execution responsibility, platform permission, workflow participation, or automation capability shall not imply acceptance or decision authority unless that authority is explicitly assigned to the governed role for the relevant scope.
Acceptance or decision rights shall be exercised only by roles whose governed definition grants those rights for the relevant purpose and information state.
Changes to role authority mappings shall follow governed change control and preserve versioned traceability.
Project BEPs shall reference governed role definitions and explicitly declare any approved project-specific specialization or variation of authority.
Automation and CDE state transitions shall not assign, transfer, or imply professional, governance, or contractual authority by technical side effect.

provenance.source_title: GAP-S1-A2 Role and Authority Governance Framework
provenance.migration_note: Source scaffold normalized against the existing governed role registry. Placeholder roles from the source were not promoted; current role definitions remain the machine-readable role authority source. Full cross-role authority/RACI coverage remains a validation gap.
